strings: PRESS BACK AGAIN TO LEAVE THE ROOM
The online service is not reachable.
ONLINE · PLAYER {n} · PRESS {A} IN THE LOBBY TO JOIN
The host runs a different version of the game.
The connection to the host was lost.
a collection of lethal party games for 2–4 subjects
FACILITY TERMINAL v{v} · ALL OUTCOMES FINAL
Every simulation is short and lethal. Placement earns points: 3 / 2 / 1 / 0. The subject with the most points when the program ends is released. The rest are not.
Empty seats are filled by facility units (bots). Read the second briefing page — it tells you how to win.
Check your internet connection and try again.
{n} REMOTE SUBJECT(S) CONNECTED — they join in the lobby with their action button
Friends anywhere choose JOIN ONLINE and type this code (PC or phone).
{A} continue to intake · {BACK} back (closes the room)
Type the room code shown on your friend's screen (HOST ONLINE).
Room codes have 6 letters and digits, e.g. K7QPXW
That code is not valid — it looks like K7QPXW.
An original fan-made homage to the "lethal party game" genre.
Design, code, procedural art & synthesized audio: built from scratch for this project.
WAITING FOR ALL SUBJECTS TO CONFIRM READY
JOIN {A} · CUSTOMIZE {MOVE} · LEAVE {B} · ADD BOT {ADDBOT} · REMOVE BOT {REMBOT} · BACK {BACK}
{n} random simulations out of {total}, with orientation and final judgement.
10 random simulations. No orientation, no ceremony.
Pick exactly which simulations to run, in random order.
EVERY SUBJECT PRESS {A} WHEN READY · {B} PREVIOUS PAGE
{names} — TIE. THE FACILITY WILL DECIDE LATER.
All other subjects will be recycled.
NEED AT LEAST {n} SUBJECTS — TAP +BOT TO ADD A BOT
NEED AT LEAST {n} SUBJECTS — PRESS {ADDBOT} TO ADD A BOT
Mind the gap. There is only one gap. It is taken.
Be inside a GREEN nook every time the train comes through.
Nooks light GREEN (safe) or RED (a press drops) before each train.
There is always one fewer safe nook than survivors.
One body per nook. Shove an occupant to drag them out.
Steam vents clear the nooks after every train.
Every subject is now an extension cord.
You never stop running. Steer with {MOVE}.
You drag a live cable behind you. It gets longer as the test goes on.
Touching any cable or the fence is fatal — yours included.
Press {A} for a short sprint. The pace rises after 25 seconds.
Please be seated. Standing is a terminal offence.
Be seated every time the music stops.
While the music plays the chairs are electrified. Touching one stuns you.
When it stops, reach a free chair and press {A} to sit. One subject per chair.
Whoever is still standing drops through a trapdoor. Then a chair is removed.
Shove ({B}) rivals into live chairs — or off a seat.
Measure twice. Cut once. Die never, ideally.
Carve the pattern on the monitor correctly, every time.
The monitor shows which blocks to remove (hollow squares). Carve your slab to match.
{A} chisels or restores the block under your cursor. {B} submits.
When time runs out, every wrong slab earns its carver a visit from the ceiling turret.
Patterns get bigger and the clock gets shorter. Survive all eight.
The floor is condemned. So are you.
Every tile you stand on cracks and drops into the shaft one second later.
Press {A} to hop. In the air you touch nothing and can clear a one-tile hole.
Every 15 seconds the floor fails on its own. Red tiles drop after one second.
Shove rivals toward the holes. Gravity handles the paperwork.
Collect the most golden rations without getting flattened.
The crane drops freight all shift. A red shadow marks every impact.
Stand in a shadow when the load lands and you are flattened.
Walk over golden rations for points. Survivors outrank the flattened.
Drops speed up and heavy pallets hit wider. {B} shoves.
The only way out is up. The machine disagrees.
Climb to the top of your down-running escalator before it feeds you to the crusher.
Press the direction on your monitor to climb one step.
Wrong direction: you stumble down two steps.
The escalator keeps speeding up. The bottom has teeth.
First to the top places highest.
Lowest output gets a crate. From above.
Have the most crates in your zone when the shift ends — and never the fewest.
Point the stick where you want to go; the forklift turns and accelerates.
{A} lifts a crate in front of the forks, {A} again sets it down.
Crates in your coloured zone score. Stealing is encouraged. {B} honks and bumps.
After 45 s the lowest scorer is crushed. Ties for last are crushed together.
Half of it is load-bearing. Allegedly.
Cross the bridge before it collapses. First across wins.
Every row has two panes. One is tempered. The other is a formality.
Broken panes stay broken. A pane that holds someone for a moment glows green.
Press {B} to shove a rival onto untested glass. Science thanks them.
At zero the bridge is decommissioned — with everyone still on it.
Sit down. Stay down. Mind the fence.
Hold the pressure plate alone for the most seconds.
Stand on the glowing plate alone to earn 1 point per second.
Two or more on it is contested — nobody scores. Shove them off.
Every ~12 s the plate relocates. A red ring marks the next spot.
The fence is electrified. Fried subjects rank below every survivor.
It only wants a hug. A very short, very final hug.
Do not be wearing the spider when its fuse runs out.
The spider clings to your back. Press {A} to throw it at someone.
Missed throws land — the spider then hunts the nearest subject.
The red eye blinks faster as the hidden fuse burns down.
Whoever wears it at zero gets folded in half.
Culture is flammable. So are you.
Burn the art, spare the machinery, and do not finish last.
Press {A} while an item is in your glowing zone to hurl it into the furnace.
Art burned: +1. Machine part burned: −1. Art that slips past: −1.
The belt speeds up. Every lane gets the same items.
Lowest score at the whistle is fed to the furnace.
Red beams sweep at ankle height. Press {A} to jump over them.
Magenta beams sweep at head height. They only burn subjects in the air.
Beams multiply, speed up and sometimes reverse.
Shoved subjects cannot jump for a moment.
Walk on green. Hold very, very still on red.
Reach the exit door at the far end of the hall.
Move while the sentry lamp is GREEN. YELLOW means stop now.
Anything moving under a RED lamp gets shot.
Shove rivals with {B} — a shoved subject is a moving subject.
Finish order decides placement. After 55 s the hall is cleared.
Everyone gets a turn with the rifle. Everyone gets a turn being the deer.
Score the most points: escape as a runner, drop runners as the hunter.
Each player hunts once from the nest while the others run for the green exit.
Headshots kill instantly. A body hit wounds; a second one finishes the job.
Cover blocks bullets. Escaping scores +2, every kill scores the hunter +1.
Possession is nine-tenths of the blast radius.
Do not be holding the bomb when it goes off.
A random subject is issued a live bomb. Pass it on before it detonates.
Touch someone to hand it over, or press {A} to toss it at the subject in front of you.
The fuse is hidden. The beeping speeds up as it nears zero.
The holder moves faster. Everyone else can shove with {B}.
Tidy desk, long life. Messy desk, flat life.
Never hold the most junk when the pistons slam.
Junk rains onto the platforms. Grab it ({A}) and throw it at rivals ({A}).
Every 10 s the pistons slam: the biggest junk pile gets pressed flat.
Junk in your hands counts toward your pile.
A direct hit knocks a subject back — maybe into the pit.
Every tank has a limit. So do you.
Bank the most pressure before time runs out.
Hold {A} to pump. Pressure climbs faster the longer you hold.
Press {B} to bank: the pressure joins your score and the tank vents.
Each tank bursts at a hidden limit (40–100). A burst loses the fill, stuns you and costs a strike.
The needle trembles near the limit. The third burst is fatal. Unbanked pressure at the buzzer is worthless.
Slow hands are a liability. Liabilities are removed.
Press faster than everyone else. Be the last subject with lives left.
When the screen turns green and says DRAW, press {A} as fast as you can.
The slowest subject of each heat loses one of two lives. Not pressing within 1.2 s also costs a life.
Press before the screen turns green and you are zapped for a false start. That costs a life too.
Out of lives? The ceiling gun handles the paperwork.
After 70 s the most lives left wins, then the lowest total reaction time.
The walls bite. The blades bounce.
Circular saws ricochet around the pen — more join over time.
The walls are lined with hacksaws. Touching them is fatal.
Some assembly required. Some funerals included.
Build a pistol at your own bench, then be the last subject standing.
Grab parts off the belt and install them at YOUR bench. Duplicates are rejected.
Frame + slide + barrel + magazine = a pistol. Six rounds. Every hit kills.
Shove carriers to make them drop their part. Benches and crates stop bullets.
Out of ammo? Install another magazine to reload.
Fifteen minutes of relaxation. Mandatory. Graded.
Take the most good puffs before the break ends.
Hold {A} to fill your lungs. Release inside the green zone for a good puff.
Too early does nothing. Fill to the top and you cough for 2 seconds.
The zone moves after every puff.
Fewest puffs when the break ends is shown the exit. By the turret.
Hold to inhale, release to puff
Stand still and listen. The harvester is not listening.
Cross the minefield and reach the exit gate.
The mines are invisible. Stand still to send a sonar ping that reveals nearby ones.
A mine takes out everyone within arm's reach.
After 12 s the harvester starts rolling up behind you — and it speeds up.
Finish order decides placement. Shoving is allowed.
The turntable drags you around and flings you outward — faster and faster.
Every 15 seconds the outer ring breaks away. It flashes red first.
Off the edge is a long way down.
Press {B} to shove rivals toward the rim.
After 70 seconds the disc stops. Survivors share the win.
Dinner is served. Manners are enforced.
Clean your plate first — without being seen eating.
{A} loads a pea onto your fork (three max). {B} eats the forkful.
When the host lowers his paper and his eyes glow red, touch nothing.
A rustle and a creak come first. Sometimes he is only bluffing.
At the 60 second gong, the guest with the most peas left is excused. Permanently.
Stay on solid floor longer than everyone else.
The monitors name a symbol. When the horn sounds, every plate with that symbol drops.
Stand over a missing plate and you fall. The shaft has no bottom worth mentioning.
Plates swap symbols every few cycles. Shove rivals onto the doomed ones.
Find the syringe and infect everyone — or stay clean until the clock runs out.
Hold {A} at a locker, cabinet or desk to search it. One of them hides the syringe.
The finder is infected. Infected subjects are slightly faster and stab others with {A} to convert them.
Clean subjects shove the infected to stun them. At time-out the infected are purged.
The air is fresh. The walls are hungry.
Giant fans blow across the hall. Walk into the wind to hold your ground.
The wind changes sides every few seconds. Warning lights flash on the next fan bank.
The walls are lined with shredders. Touching them is fatal.
No wind reaches the lee of a pillar. Shove rivals downwind with {B}.
The ducts are quiet. Keep it that way.
Collect the most data chips without being found.
Data chips lie in the ducts. Each one is worth a point.
Security drones hunt by sound. Moving is loud; standing still is quiet.
Grabbing a chip makes noise. A second drone joins after 25 seconds.
Drone contact is fatal. The living outrank the dead.
Crank your lift to the hatch before the grinder catches up.
Alternate {A} and {B} to crank your winch. Every clean turn lifts your platform.
Pressing the same button twice slips the ratchet: you drop and stall for a moment.
The winch has a top speed. Mashing faster than it turns is wasted effort.
The grinder below rises faster and faster. First through the hatch wins.
Kill a subject who finished their gun before you did.
Land a headshot as the hunter.
Win Alcove Roulette from the final safe alcove.
Throw the spider with less than one second on its fuse.
Knock a rival off their platform with thrown junk.
Still be standing when only ten tiles remain.
Reach the top of the escalator without a single misstep.
Clean your plate in under 20 seconds.
Infect someone within 3 seconds of finding the syringe.
Survive every pattern of the Chisel Test.
Cross the minefield without ever using sonar.
Hold four crates in your zone at once.
Good evening, subjects. Welcome to the facility.
Tonight you will participate in a series of entertaining simulations.
Each simulation has a winner. Losing is discouraged. Permanently.
Points are awarded for placement. The subject with the most points will be released.
The others will be repurposed. Please enjoy the party.
The program is complete. Your cooperation has been noted.
Results have been tabulated by an impartial machine.
Runners: reach the green exit, {B} dives
Grab parts from the belt ▸ build your pistol at your bench ▸ use it
Hold {A} at a container to search it
Stand on the plate alone to score · {B} shoves
Grab golden rations · dodge red shadows · {B} shoves
{MOVE} on green · freeze on red · {B} shoves
Press {A} the moment the screen turns green
{MOVE} crawl · {B} shove · stand still to stay quiet
Magenta burns the airborne — stay down
When the music stops: {A} sits · {B} shoves
Alternate {A} and {B} to crank · same button twice slips

UNIT-2 tossed the bomb to SUBJECT 1

UNIT-2 tripped over their own cable
SUBJECT 1 sent UNIT-2 down the shaft
SUBJECT 1 tripped UNIT-2 into a beam
